description: Read one node's full markdown body + frontmatter by node_id. Response includes outbound_links[] (resolved graph edges) unless with_links:false, plus source attribution. Pass heading (e.g. "Tactics") to get ONLY that markdown section — a few hundred chars instead of the whole body; every heading read, hit or miss, carries the node's headings list, and a miss is heading_not_found — so a guessed heading is cheap (heading "" just lists the headings). A heading read is partial — never write it back as a node's content; re-read without heading first. A long body is returned one page at a time — when the response says truncated, call again with { cursor } to continue it.
name: vpshardening__read_node
